sun-aries: You define yourself through action; starting things, stepping forward and being first come naturally to you. Speed, not patience, is your strength, and impatience is the price you pay.
sun-taurus: Security, ownership and tangible results define you; you take pleasure in building something slowly but solidly. Where you dig in your heels you're often right, but not always.
sun-gemini: Curiosity, speed and words are your fuel; you can weigh two ideas at once and make two people laugh at the same time. Scattering yourself is your risk, making connections your talent.
sun-cancer: Your identity is woven from feeling and belonging; protecting, nurturing and remembering come naturally to you. Your shell is tough, but the people close to you know who's inside.
sun-leo: You were born to be seen and to create; your warmth and confidence get noticed the moment you walk into a room. When you need the applause, your generosity can fall into shadow.
sun-virgo: Order, craft and usefulness define you; you see the details and do the job right. The standards you hold yourself to are always stricter than the ones you apply to others.
sun-libra: Balance, beauty and relationships are your center; you sense what's fair and soften conflict. Trying to please everyone sometimes makes you forget your own side.
sun-scorpio: Intensity and depth are your nature; you can't stay on the surface, and you read secrets and real intentions. You don't give your trust easily, but when you do, you give it completely.
sun-sagittarius: The search for meaning and the urge to expand define you; you look far, think big and carry people along with your optimism. You have little patience for details and limits.
sun-capricorn: Goals, discipline and time are your tools; you see the long game and carry responsibility. Success puts you at ease, but you need to learn how to rest.
sun-aquarius: Originality and ideas define you; you think outside the box and love from a distance, but loyally. Your distance is sometimes read as coldness, when it's really just breathing room.
sun-pisces: Intuition and compassion are your center; your boundaries are fluid, and you feel what others feel as if it were your own. Your pull toward escape is big, and so is your power to heal.
moon-aries: Your feelings flare up fast and burn out fast; to feel safe you need movement and honest reactions. Being kept waiting doesn't warm you up, it burns you.
moon-taurus: To feel safe you need stability, touch and routine; you warm up slowly and let go late. Change is hard on you; continuity heals you.
moon-gemini: Your feelings work through words; talking, explaining and being understood put you at ease. Your moods shift quickly, and curiosity carries you from one feeling to the next; love that stays silent may not count as love to you.
moon-cancer: The Moon is at home here: your feelings run deep, your memory is long and your protective instinct is strong. Closeness means home to you, and emotional distance means danger.
moon-leo: You want to be seen and appreciated emotionally; you have a generous, warm and dramatic heart. Being left in the shadows cools you from the inside.
moon-virgo: To relax you need order and a sense of purpose; your worrying is often how you express love. Letting go of self-criticism is your biggest emotional task.
moon-libra: You find peace in harmony and beauty; fighting wears you down from the inside. Putting your own needs on hold to keep the peace is the trap you fall into most often.
moon-scorpio: Your feelings are deep, hidden and intense; without loyalty and wholeness you don't feel safe. Once you're hurt, forgetting isn't a talent you were given.
moon-sagittarius: Freedom and hope put you at ease; you process feelings through humor and movement. Feeling trapped makes you bolt faster than anyone.
moon-capricorn: You keep your feelings under control and express them through responsibility; for you, trust is proven over time. You may look cool, but there's a deep devotion inside you.
moon-aquarius: You observe your feelings from a distance and process them by thinking; for you, freedom is safety. You come to closeness at your own pace, on your own terms.
moon-pisces: Your intuition speaks before your feelings do; you carry other people's pain as if it were your own. Setting boundaries doesn't make you selfish; it keeps you going.
mercury-aries: You think fast and speak directly; in an argument, the first word is yours. When your listening catches up with your speed, your power to persuade doubles.
mercury-taurus: You think slowly but solidly; you don't voice an idea until you've digested it. Changing your mind takes time, but your word can be trusted.
mercury-gemini: Mercury is at home here: a nimble, curious, versatile mind. You understand everything; the challenge is sticking with one thing for long.
mercury-cancer: You think with feeling and speak from memory; your tone says more than your words. When you're hurt, your words pull inward too.
mercury-leo: When you talk, it's a stage: warm, captivating, self-assured. When you believe you're right, hearing the other side can get hard.
mercury-virgo: Mercury is at home here: analytical, precise, detail-oriented. You find the right word; getting the dose of criticism right is your only task.
mercury-libra: You build your thoughts by weighing them and keeping the other person in mind; diplomacy comes naturally to you. Making a decision is harder than seeing the options.
mercury-scorpio: You think more with what you leave unsaid than with what you say; you read intentions and sense a lie. Your words can cut, because they hit the mark.
mercury-sagittarius: You talk about the big picture and what it all means; you love to teach and spread ideas. Slipping on the details is the price of your strength.
mercury-capricorn: Your thinking is structured and your speech economical; you don't waste words. Your seriousness is sometimes taken for distance.
mercury-aquarius: You think outside the box and see ideas from a distance; science and society draw your mind. An idea you stubbornly hold on to feels like freedom to you.
mercury-pisces: You think in dreams and intuition; your logic works in images. Sometimes words aren't enough, and then art or silence does the talking.
venus-aries: In love you're bold and direct; the chase and making the first move excite you. The flame burns fast; keeping it going is an art of its own.
venus-taurus: Venus is at home here: touch, taste, loyalty and comfort are your love language. You attach slowly and let go reluctantly.
venus-gemini: For you, mental attraction comes before physical attraction; whoever makes you laugh and gets you talking wins. Routine wears love out fast for you.
venus-cancer: Your love is protective and nurturing; you love someone like a home of your own. When you don't feel safe, you pull back.
venus-leo: Your love is generous, showy and loyal; you put the person you love in the spotlight and cheer them on. In return you expect admiration, and when you don't see it, you cool inside.
venus-virgo: You show love through service, care and small fixes; usefulness speaks louder than words. Perfectionism can wear a relationship down, yet flaws are part of love too.
venus-libra: Venus is at home here: grace, harmony and give-and-take are your language. Avoiding conflict sometimes hides what you really want.
venus-scorpio: You love intensely, possessively and deeply; half-hearted commitment isn't enough for you. Beneath your jealousy lies a desire to transform.
venus-sagittarius: Without freedom and adventure, love feels cramped to you; exploring together is the most romantic thing there is for you. When you don't confuse commitment with running away, you can be both free and close.
venus-capricorn: Your love is serious, loyal and proven over time; to you, reliability is attractive. Showing feelings is harder for you than performing.
venus-aquarius: Friendship is the foundation of love for you; you love people who are original and who give you room. Too much closeness makes you back away at first.
venus-pisces: You love with compassion, without limits and by intuition; romance isn't an escape for you but a belief. The gap between the ideal and the real can hurt.
mars-aries: Mars is at home here: you ask directly for what you want and act fast. Your anger comes quickly and goes quickly; patience is your training ground.
mars-taurus: A slow but unstoppable force; once you're on your way, you don't tire. Changing plans annoy you more than anyone.
mars-gemini: The way you act is nimble and verbal; you like to settle things by talking them through. Taking on too much at once scatters your strength.
mars-cancer: You act indirectly but with resolve; protecting the people you love is what moves you most. You tend to hold your anger in.
mars-leo: You act in a bold, showy and warm way; being the center of attention makes you stronger. When your pride is hurt, you can get pulled into a power struggle.
mars-virgo: The way you act is meticulous and measured; if you're going to do something, you do it right. Sloppiness really gets to you; your craftsmanship shows in your sexuality too.
mars-libra: You don't like direct confrontation; you get what you want through grace and persuasion. Hesitating in the moment of decision can wear you out.
mars-scorpio: You use your will quietly, strategically and at full force; you don't do things halfway. Your anger is invisible but unforgettable.
mars-sagittarius: The way you act is broad and optimistic; you're at your best on the move. Finishing what you start is the real challenge.
mars-capricorn: Mars is exalted here: a disciplined, calculated and enduring will. You turn emotional anger into cool determination.
mars-aquarius: You fight your own way and for your principles; pressure spurs you into action. Your unpredictable energy can surprise people.
mars-pisces: Your will moves like a wave: sometimes all in, sometimes not at all. When you act on intuition you're spot on; when you run from things, you scatter.
jupiter-aries: You grow through courage; when you take risks, your luck opens up. Too much optimism can turn into miscalculation.
jupiter-taurus: Abundance comes to you by building up over time; you find joy in tangible things you can touch. Don't let comfort get in the way of growth.
jupiter-gemini: You grow through curiosity; you learn something from everyone and pass on what you learn. Going deep pays off more than spreading wide.
jupiter-cancer: Jupiter is exalted here: you grow by protecting and looking after; your compassion brings abundance. Everything you take care of grows in your hands.
jupiter-leo: You're not afraid to think big; your generosity and warmth draw people to you. You set the dose of exaggeration yourself.
jupiter-virgo: You grow through usefulness and skill; doing the job right lifts you up. Obsessing over details can make you miss the opportunity.
jupiter-libra: Your sense of fairness and your gift for compromise are your luck; you open up alongside other people. Trying to please everyone slows your growth.
jupiter-scorpio: You draw strength from difficulty and depth; you grow where others run away. Letting go of the need for control opens the way to abundance.
jupiter-sagittarius: Jupiter is at home here: optimism, curiosity and the search for meaning are your natural state. Your horizons are wide, your patience short.
jupiter-capricorn: You grow through discipline and patience; your success is understated but lasting. Too much caution and pessimism can narrow your growth; you're also asked to learn to trust.
jupiter-aquarius: Being different brings you luck; your ideas and your vision help you grow. Detachment is the shadow of this strength, so don't forget to connect.
jupiter-pisces: You grow through compassion and intuition; your faith carries you. Limitless trust sometimes opens the wrong doors.
saturn-aries: Trusting yourself and taking action is your lesson; fear of failure keeps you sometimes on the brakes, sometimes on the gas. When you learn courage through discipline, your will becomes unshakable.
saturn-taurus: To feel safe you want concrete proof; fear of loss makes you careful with what you have. The feeling of being enough doesn't come from outside; it's built from within.
saturn-gemini: You may have felt inadequate at thinking and communicating; through discipline you grow into a masterful mind. You say little, but it hits the mark.
saturn-cancer: Emotional security is your toughest school; showing love can feel heavy to you. The tenderness you learn becomes unshakable.
saturn-leo: You grow up between the need to be seen and a sense of shame; real confidence comes from acceptance, not achievement. You take your creativity more seriously than anyone.
saturn-virgo: Perfectionism is your test; you're asked to learn where good enough lies. Your skill is real and well earned.
saturn-libra: Commitment is your lesson; you learn to take on responsibility, or to stop taking on too much. Decisions take you time, but the ones you make last.
saturn-scorpio: Control, trust and loss are your test; learning to let go makes you stronger. For you, depth comes with seriousness.
saturn-sagittarius: You question your beliefs and build your own meaning; you don't trust ready-made answers. For you, learning comes with time and effort.
saturn-capricorn: Saturn is at home here: responsibility, goals and authority come naturally to you. Success is inevitable; taking a break is the hard part.
saturn-aquarius: You find your way between freedom and responsibility; feeling part of a group takes time. You learn the system first, then change it.
saturn-pisces: Blurry boundaries are your test; you're asked to balance trust in your intuition with structure. Through discipline, your compassion becomes a practical strength.
uranus-aries: Independence is like breathing to you; your breaks are sudden and bold. You don't wait for anyone to get started.
uranus-taurus: Even as you tear down the familiar, you look for solid ground; for you, security runs through freedom. Stubbornness and innovation sit side by side in you.
uranus-gemini: Your ideas strike like lightning; thinking outside the box is your natural state. When you're bored, you change the subject instantly.
uranus-cancer: You build belonging in your own way; tradition feels too tight for you. Your feelings can swing suddenly.
uranus-leo: Your creativity is unusual and flashy; you end up in the spotlight at unexpected moments. Being original is a matter of pride for you.
uranus-virgo: You find your own method; routine makes you rebel. Spotting the flaw and rebuilding the system is your reflex.
uranus-libra: You look for your own balance between equality and distance; ready-made molds don't fit you. You combine your sense of fairness with innovation.
uranus-scorpio: You approach transformation suddenly and radically; breaking taboos doesn't scare you. Your intensity erupts at unexpected moments.
uranus-sagittarius: You have the nerve to build your own philosophy; ready-made beliefs feel too tight for you. For you, freedom means freedom of thought.
uranus-capricorn: You choose unusual goals; you don't want to tear authority down but to rebuild it. Patience and rebellion sit side by side in you.
uranus-aquarius: Uranus is at home here: original thinking, independence and innovation are your natural state. Being ordinary is the only risk for you.
uranus-pisces: Your intuition works through sudden insights; you're sensitive to what the collective feels. Boundaries dissolving both frees you and wears you out.
neptune-aries: Your idealism lives in action; the gap between the dream of heroism and reality is your source of inspiration. Your identity is fluid, your courage romantic.
neptune-taurus: Your intuition speaks through tangible things; beauty and comfort are a spiritual experience for you. Disorder is the shadow of this sensitivity.
neptune-gemini: Your words flow with compassion and intuition; you hear what people leave unsaid. Your mind is poetic, and your attention wanders easily.
neptune-cancer: Your longing for home is deep, but your roots can feel uncertain; your compassion knows no bounds. Your emotional sensitivity runs higher than anyone's.
neptune-leo: Glamour and magic draw you in; being seen inspires you, and taking the stage comes naturally. The gap between the dream you build and reality sometimes turns into disappointment.
neptune-virgo: A wish to serve and trouble setting boundaries go together in you; while helping, you can forget yourself. Healing is your natural inclination.
neptune-libra: You tend to idealize relationships; rescuing a partner or losing yourself in them may feel familiar. Your dream of harmony is truly big.
neptune-scorpio: Your intuition runs deep and your urge to escape is strong; you turn intensity into a spiritual search. Mystery is your natural climate.
neptune-sagittarius: Your spiritual search is strong and your trust in ready-made answers low; you find meaning by feeling it. Faraway places pull at your imagination.
neptune-capricorn: You combine dreams with realism; part of you works from inspiration but keeps its feet on the ground. A goal without meaning won't carry you for long.
neptune-aquarius: You have an intuitive bridge between the ideal of humanity and real friendship; big shared dreams draw you in. Distance and compassion sit side by side in you.
neptune-pisces: Neptune is at home here: intuition, empathy and boundlessness at their strongest. Your compassion and your flair for art define you.
pluto-aries: Your will is strong and your drive to transform is determined; backing down feels like defeat to you. For you, power is part of who you are.
pluto-taurus: You have a deep sense of power and possession; letting go of what you value is hard for you. When you tear down and rebuild, you do it slowly but for good.
pluto-gemini: Your words are highly persuasive; your mind is piercing, your tongue seductive. Variety draws you in, and committing to just one thing is hard.
pluto-cancer: You have a deep, transformative bond with your roots and your past; your attachment runs intense. For you, security shapes everything.
pluto-leo: Passion and a desire for control go together in you; you commit with all your strength to what you create. Pride is a matter of existence for you.
pluto-virgo: You work with passion and in depth; you can't rest once you've spotted a flaw. For you, renewal comes through discipline.
pluto-libra: You have deep learning to do between commitment and control; the balance of power in a relationship transforms you. Surface-level harmony isn't enough for you.
pluto-scorpio: Pluto is at home here: your power of transformation is at its most intense. For you, a crisis isn't an ending but a beginning.
pluto-sagittarius: You have a deep search for meaning and a resistance to dogma; you want to find the truth yourself. The more your faith is questioned, the stronger it gets.
pluto-capricorn: Your generation transformed authority and the system; in you there's a strong, goal-driven, sometimes ruthless determination.
pluto-aquarius: Collective transformation and original power go together in you; you want to change the system at its roots. Your independence isn't up for negotiation.
pluto-pisces: You have an intuitive power and a hidden capacity to heal; you grow stronger where boundaries dissolve. Your compassion transforms people from the inside.
ascendant-aries: You enter the world fast and direct; your first impression is courage and energy. People see you first and get to know you later.
ascendant-taurus: You leave a calm, reliable and grounded first impression; you warm up slowly and stand firm. Comfort and beauty shape how you see life.
ascendant-gemini: You come across as curious, chatty and lively; how quickly you adapt to a room gets noticed. People listen to you first.
ascendant-cancer: You come across as soft, protective and intuitive; you feel things out before you get close. Once trust is earned, your shell opens.
ascendant-leo: You have a warm, confident presence that gets noticed; when you walk into a room, the light turns to you. Your generosity is the first thing people pick up from you.
ascendant-virgo: You come across as orderly, measured and attentive; people trust you with things. Your first impression is seriousness and competence.
ascendant-libra: You leave a graceful, balanced and kind first impression; people relax around you. When it's time to decide, you may weigh things and wait.
ascendant-scorpio: You have an intense, mysterious and piercing gaze; people can't figure you out right away. Your distance is power; your closeness brings transformation.
ascendant-sagittarius: You come across as open, optimistic and adventurous; you give people confidence and joy. Your directness can sometimes be unfiltered.
ascendant-capricorn: You leave a serious, composed and mature first impression; you come across as goal-focused and dependable. You warm up over time, and life gets lighter as you get older.
ascendant-aquarius: You come across as different, free-spirited and friendly; people can't put you in a box. Your distance is really an equal closeness to everyone.
ascendant-pisces: You come across as soft, dreamy and compassionate; you take on the mood of the room. Setting boundaries is how you protect yourself.
